key.name: video-path
key.description: Any file mpv can play. Empty means clip.mp4 in ~/.local/share/settle-lockscreen.

key.name: lock-play-seconds
key.summary: Longest the video plays at a time
key.description: Seconds of playback on one lock, counted only while the display is on. Then the video settles into a still.

key.name: settle-delay-ms
key.summary: How long the video keeps moving after unlock

key.name: settle-ramp-ms
key.summary: How long the slow-down to a stop takes

key.name: play-in-power-saver
key.summary: Play while the power-saver profile is on

key.name: hardware-decoding
key.summary: Decode the video on the GPU when it can
key.description: Turn off if the video glitches or tears on your GPU.
